{\textbf{PetXp}} = ( \text{TotalCXP}^{K}\times(1+\text{Summon}^{1.5}) \times (1+\frac{1}{10}\text{CastsThisExile}^{0.5})+\text{FixedXp})\times \text{PetXpMultiplier}
